title: Reject an MCP initialize result without protocolVersion
goal: Make the Core harness MCP handshake fail closed when the server omits the required protocolVersion while preserving known and explicitly unsupported non-empty revisions.

results.change: McpClient now rejects an initialize result whose protocolVersion is missing, non-string, or empty before sending notifications/initialized or marking the session ready; non-empty revisions, including unsupported ones, retain their existing behavior
results.acceptance: cargo test --offline --locked -p susi-harness --lib mcp: 18 passed, 0 failed
results.boundary: Core harness MCP handshake only; no dependency, Commercial, Minijinja, release, or credential changes
